page.title: 数が多い？ 量が多い？

analysis.summaryJa: manyは数えられる複数名詞の『数の多さ』、muchは不可算名詞の『量の多さ』を表す。muchは特に疑問文・否定文で自然で、肯定会話では可算・不可算の両方に使えるa lot ofが便利である。前ページのbothは複数一致、either/neitherは単数一致という数の感覚も合わせて確認する。
grammarPoints: many + 複数可算名詞で数の多さを表す
much + 不可算名詞で量の多さを表す
How many + 複数可算名詞 / How much + 不可算名詞を使い分ける
muchは疑問文・否定文で特に自然で、肯定会話ではa lot ofが使いやすい
a lot ofは複数可算名詞にも不可算名詞にも使える
both + 複数一致、either/neither + 単数一致を数量感覚と結び付ける
visualEvidence: manyの皿でコインを一枚ずつ数える秤
muchの皿で水の量を測る秤
a lot ofが数と量の両方を橋渡しする道具
Both maps are / Either map is / Neither map is の一致ストリップ
muchは疑問・否定が得意という利用メモ
commonTraps: 複数可算名詞にmuchを使う
How manyの後ろを単数名詞にする
肯定会話で不自然にmuchを多用する
equipmentやfeedbackなどの不可算名詞を複数化する
both/either/neitherの単複一致を混同する

questions.prompt: How ------- customer inquiries did the support team receive yesterday?
questions.translationJa: サポートチームは昨日、顧客からの問い合わせを何件受けましたか。
questions.explanationJa: inquiriesは数えられる複数名詞なので、数を尋ねるHow manyを使います。

questions.prompt: How ------- storage space is included with the basic plan?
questions.translationJa: 基本プランにはどのくらいの保存容量が含まれていますか。
questions.explanationJa: spaceはここでは不可算名詞なので、量を尋ねるHow muchを使います。

questions.prompt: We don't have ------- time before the client arrives, so let's begin now.
questions.translationJa: 顧客が到着するまであまり時間がないので、今始めましょう。
questions.explanationJa: timeは不可算名詞で、否定文ではmuch timeが自然です。

questions.prompt: The new branch receives ------- of walk-in customers during the lunch hour.
questions.translationJa: 新しい支店には昼休みに多くの来店客が訪れます。
questions.explanationJa: a lot ofは可算複数customersにも使え、肯定文で自然な『多くの』を表します。
questions.focus: a lot of + 可算複数

questions.prompt: The training center has ------- classrooms on the second floor.
questions.translationJa: 研修センターの2階には多くの教室があります。
questions.explanationJa: classroomsは複数可算名詞なのでmanyが適切です。

questions.prompt: The revised layout provides ------- of additional workspace for the design team.
questions.translationJa: 改訂されたレイアウトにより、設計チームには多くの追加作業スペースが確保されます。
questions.explanationJa: workspaceは不可算的に扱え、肯定文ではa lot of workspaceが自然です。
questions.focus: a lot of + 不可算名詞

questions.prompt: There wasn't ------- traffic on the highway this morning.
questions.translationJa: 今朝、高速道路はそれほど混雑していませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: trafficは不可算名詞で、否定文ではmuch trafficが自然です。

questions.prompt: ------- documents were missing from the application, so processing started immediately.
questions.translationJa: 申請書類で不足しているものはほとんどなかったため、すぐに処理が始まりました。
questions.explanationJa: documentsは可算複数なので数量にはmany/few系が対応します。ここでは『不足がほとんどない』文脈からFewです。

questions.prompt: Both conference rooms ------- large enough for thirty participants.
questions.translationJa: 2つの会議室はどちらも30人を収容できる十分な広さです。
questions.explanationJa: Both + 複数名詞roomsは複数主語なのでareを使います。

questions.prompt: Neither delivery option ------- an extra handling fee.
questions.translationJa: どちらの配送方法にも追加取扱手数料は必要ありません。
questions.explanationJa: Neither + 単数名詞optionは単数扱いなのでrequiresを使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the grammatically correct sentence about countable reservations.

choices.A: We received much reservations this morning.
choices.B: We received many reservation this morning.
choices.C: We received many reservations this morning.
choices.D: We received much reservation this morning.

questions.translationJa: 今朝、多くの予約を受け付けました。
questions.explanationJa: reservationsは複数可算名詞なのでmanyを使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about an uncountable amount of work.

choices.A: We don't have many work left to do.
choices.B: We don't have much works left to do.
choices.C: We don't have many works left to do.
choices.D: We don't have much work left to do.

questions.translationJa: 残っている作業はそれほど多くありません。
questions.explanationJa: workはこの意味では不可算名詞で、否定文なのでmuch workが自然です。

questions.prompt: Choose the most natural everyday affirmative sentence about available seating.

choices.A: The lobby has a lot of seating.
choices.D: The lobby has a lot seating.

questions.translationJa: ロビーには座席スペースがたくさんあります。
questions.explanationJa: seatingは不可算名詞で、肯定文ではa lot of seatingが自然です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct question asking for a number of copies.

choices.A: How much copies should I print?
choices.B: How many copies should I print?
choices.C: How many copy should I print?
choices.D: How much copy should I print?

questions.translationJa: 何部印刷すればよいですか。
questions.explanationJa: copiesは数えられる複数名詞なのでHow many copiesを使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct question asking about an amount of fuel.

choices.A: How many fuel remains in the tank?
choices.B: How much fuels remain in the tank?
choices.C: How much fuel remains in the tank?
choices.D: How many fuels remain in the tank?

questions.translationJa: タンクにはどのくらい燃料が残っていますか。
questions.explanationJa: fuelは不可算名詞なのでHow much fuelが正しい形です。

questions.prompt: Choose the natural affirmative sentence about a large quantity of equipment.

choices.A: The laboratory has many new equipment.
choices.B: The laboratory has much new equipments.
choices.C: The laboratory has a lot of new equipments.
choices.D: The laboratory has a lot of new equipment.

questions.translationJa: 研究室には新しい設備がたくさんあります。
questions.explanationJa: equipmentは不可算名詞で、肯定文ではa lot of equipmentが自然です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct negative sentence about money.

choices.A: We didn't spend much money on transportation.
choices.B: We didn't spend many money on transportation.
choices.C: We didn't spend much monies on transportation.
choices.D: We didn't spend many monies on transportation.

questions.translationJa: 交通費にはそれほどお金を使いませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: moneyは不可算名詞で、否定文の『多くは〜ない』にはmuchを使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about numerous service requests.

choices.A: Much service requests were resolved within an hour.
choices.B: Many service requests were resolved within an hour.
choices.C: Many service request was resolved within an hour.
choices.D: Much service request were resolved within an hour.

questions.translationJa: 多くのサービス依頼が1時間以内に解決されました。
questions.explanationJa: requestsは複数可算名詞なのでManyと複数動詞wereを使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about two brochures.

choices.A: Both brochure includes a map of the venue.
choices.B: Either brochures include a map of the venue.
choices.C: Both brochures include a map of the venue.
choices.D: Neither brochures includes a map of the venue.

questions.translationJa: 2種類のパンフレットにはどちらも会場地図が載っています。
questions.explanationJa: Both brochuresは複数主語なのでincludeを使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about either of two offices.

choices.A: Either offices are able to process the request.
choices.B: Both office is able to process the request.
choices.C: Neither offices is able to process the request when either one can.
choices.D: Either office is able to process the request.

questions.translationJa: 2つの事務所のどちらでも、その依頼を処理できます。
questions.explanationJa: Either officeは単数扱いなのでisを取ります。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The company received a large number of applications.”
questions.translationJa: その会社には多くの応募がありました。
questions.explanationJa: a large number of + 複数可算名詞はmany + 複数名詞で言い換えられます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “There isn't a large amount of room in the vehicle.”

choices.A: There isn't much room in the vehicle.
choices.B: There aren't many room in the vehicle.
choices.C: There isn't many rooms when room means space.
choices.D: There isn't much rooms in the vehicle.

questions.translationJa: その車内にはあまりスペースがありません。
questions.explanationJa: roomが『空間』の意味では不可算なので、否定文でmuch roomが対応します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The venue has plenty of parking.”

choices.D: The venue has a lot of parking.

questions.translationJa: その会場には駐車スペースがたくさんあります。
questions.explanationJa: parkingは不可算的に扱われ、肯定文のplenty ofはa lot ofで自然に言い換えられます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “We received numerous complaints after the update.”

choices.A: We received much complaints after the update.
choices.B: We received much complaint after the update.
choices.C: We received many complaints after the update.
choices.D: We received a lot complaint after the update.

questions.translationJa: 更新後、多くの苦情が寄せられました。
questions.explanationJa: numerousは複数可算名詞の多さを表すためmany complaintsが対応します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The project doesn't require a large amount of time.”

choices.A: The project doesn't require many time.
choices.B: The project doesn't require much time.
choices.C: The project doesn't require much times.

questions.translationJa: そのプロジェクトにはそれほど多くの時間は必要ありません。
questions.explanationJa: timeは不可算名詞で、否定文ではmuch timeが自然です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The office has plenty of natural light.”

choices.A: The office has a lot of natural light.
choices.B: The office has many natural light.
choices.C: The office has much natural lights.
choices.D: The office has a lot natural light.

questions.translationJa: そのオフィスには自然光がたくさん入ります。
questions.explanationJa: lightはこの意味では不可算で、肯定文ではa lot of lightが自然です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “A large number of employees joined the webinar.”
questions.translationJa: 多くの従業員がウェビナーに参加しました。
questions.explanationJa: employeesは複数可算名詞なのでmanyで数量を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “There was not a great deal of noise in the office.”

choices.A: There weren't many noise in the office.
choices.B: There wasn't many noises when general sound is meant.
choices.C: There wasn't much noise in the office.
choices.D: There wasn't much noises in the office.

questions.translationJa: オフィスはそれほどうるさくありませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: noiseを一般的な音量として不可算で捉え、否定文ではmuch noiseが自然です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The two reports are complete.”
questions.translationJa: 2つの報告書は両方とも完成しています。
questions.explanationJa: 二つとも同じ状態にあることはBoth + 複数名詞で表せます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “One or the other of the two schedules will work.”
questions.translationJa: 2つの日程のどちらでも問題ありません。
questions.explanationJa: 二つのうちどちらか一方ならよいという意味はEither + 単数名詞で表します。

questions.prompt: Customer survey: How ------- locations did you visit before choosing this store?
questions.translationJa: 顧客アンケート：この店舗を選ぶ前に何店舗訪れましたか。
questions.explanationJa: locationsは数えられる複数名詞なのでHow manyを使います。

questions.prompt: Travel note: We don't have ------- flexibility in the return schedule because the last train leaves at 9:10.
questions.translationJa: 出張メモ：最終列車が9時10分発なので、帰りの日程にはあまり融通が利きません。
questions.explanationJa: flexibilityは不可算名詞で、否定文ではmuch flexibilityが自然です。

questions.prompt: Office announcement: The renovated lounge now has ------- of space for informal meetings.
questions.translationJa: 社内告知：改装されたラウンジには、打ち合わせ用のスペースがたくさんあります。
questions.explanationJa: 肯定文で不可算名詞spaceの多さを自然に表すためa lot ofを使います。

questions.prompt: Sales report: ------- new accounts were opened during the promotion, especially in the first week.
questions.translationJa: 営業報告：キャンペーン中、とくに最初の週に多くの新規口座が開設されました。
questions.explanationJa: accountsは複数可算名詞なのでManyが適切です。

questions.prompt: Warehouse email: How ------- packaging material should we order for next month's shipments?
questions.translationJa: 倉庫メール：来月の発送用に梱包材をどのくらい注文すべきですか。
questions.explanationJa: packaging materialは量として不可算的に扱うためHow muchを使います。

questions.prompt: Service update: We haven't received ------- feedback about the new feature yet, so the review period will remain open.
questions.translationJa: サービス更新：新機能についてまだあまりフィードバックが集まっていないため、レビュー期間を継続します。
questions.explanationJa: feedbackは不可算名詞で、否定文have not receivedにはmuchが自然です。

questions.prompt: Recruiting memo: The job fair attracted ------- of qualified candidates, and several interviews are already scheduled.
questions.translationJa: 採用メモ：就職説明会には多くの有資格候補者が集まり、すでに複数の面接が予定されています。
questions.explanationJa: a lot ofは複数可算名詞candidatesに使え、肯定文で自然です。
questions.focus: a lot of + 複数可算

questions.prompt: Facilities report: ------- repairs were needed after the inspection; most equipment was already in good condition.
questions.translationJa: 施設報告：点検後に必要となった修理はほとんどありませんでした。設備の大半はすでに良好な状態でした。
questions.explanationJa: repairsは可算複数で、文脈上『ほとんどない』ためFewが適切です。muchは不可算名詞用です。

questions.prompt: Meeting note: ------- projectors are available, so either room can be used for the presentation.
questions.translationJa: 会議メモ：2台のプロジェクターは両方とも使用できるため、どちらの部屋でも発表に使えます。
questions.explanationJa: 二台とも利用可能なのでBoth + 複数名詞projectorsを使います。

questions.prompt: Delivery notice: ------- pickup location is acceptable; select the one closest to your office.
questions.translationJa: 配送案内：2つの受取場所のどちらでも利用できます。オフィスに近い方を選んでください。
questions.explanationJa: 二つの候補のどちらでもよいのでEither + 単数名詞locationを使います。
